title: A Composer auth.json is served
summary: The Composer auth file is downloadable, which carries the registry tokens and HTTP credentials it authenticates with.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("http-basic") or body_contains("github-oauth") or body_contains("gitlab-token")) and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Remove the file from the web root and rotate the tokens.
